users.title: Users
users.desc: Mailboxes, the protocols they may sign in with, and their quotas.
users.addDesc: Create a mailbox in one of your domains.
users.createDefaultsUnread: Could not read the create defaults. The form is hidden so a new user does not skip them.
users.credentialsRequired: A username and password are required.
users.defaultsUnreadRetry: The create defaults of the domain could not be read, so no user was created. Select the domain again.
users.settingsFailed: Created the user, but could not apply its settings.
users.quotaFailed: Created the user, but could not set its quota.

userDetail.accountDesc: Status, mailbox type and the protocols this user may sign in with.
userDetail.quotaUsedDesc: Used space: {0}. A limit of 0 means unlimited.
userDetail.spamDesc: Inbound mail at or above this score goes to Junk. Empty inherits the domain or global threshold; an operator block or allow rule still wins.
userDetail.hideDesc: Hide this user from the lists below.
userDetail.contactDesc: How this user appears in the address book and to Outlook.
userDetail.oofDesc: Automatic replies while the user is away.
userDetail.internalReply: Reply to people inside the organization
userDetail.externalEnabled: Also reply to senders outside the organization
userDetail.externalReply: Reply to senders outside the organization
userDetail.knownOnly: Only reply to senders already in the user's contacts
userDetail.forwardDesc: Send this user's mail on to another address.
userDetail.aliasesDesc: Other addresses that deliver to this mailbox, one per line.
userDetail.altnamesDesc: Other names this user may sign in with, one per line.
userDetail.meetingDesc: How this mailbox answers the meeting requests it receives.
userDetail.autoAccept: Accept conflict-free meeting requests (otherwise added to the calendar as tentative only, with no response to the organizer)
userDetail.declineConflict: Decline all meeting requests with scheduling conflicts
userDetail.autoAcceptHint: Automatic processing requires "Accept conflict-free meeting requests". With it unchecked the mailbox does no automatic processing, so the two decline options have no effect on their own.
userDetail.removeRequest: Move the request mail to Deleted Items once it has been answered
userDetail.removeRequestHint: This applies to every response, whether a person made it or automatic processing did. It is independent of the three options above.
userDetail.processCancellations: Mark a meeting cancelled in the calendar when its cancellation arrives
userDetail.processCancellationsHint: The meeting stays in the calendar, marked cancelled and shown as free, until the user removes it. Only a cancellation from the meeting's organizer that is not older than the calendar's copy is applied.
userDetail.fetchmailDesc: Remote POP3/IMAP accounts polled into this mailbox. Keep on server leaves the originals on the source; otherwise they are deleted after fetching.
userDetail.quarantineDesc: Review this user's Junk folder for false positives and release or delete a message. Message bodies are not shown.
userDetail.delegatesDesc: People who may open this mailbox, one address per line. A delegate may not send.
userDetail.storeOwnersDesc: People who get read-write access to every object in this mailbox, one address per line.
userDetail.sendAsDesc: The message names this user in From and nobody else, so the recipient cannot tell who sent it.
userDetail.sendAsLabel: Users who may send as this user
userDetail.sendOnBehalfDesc: The message names this user in From and the sender in Sender, so the recipient sees both.
userDetail.sendOnBehalfLabel: Users who may send on this user's behalf
userDetail.sentCopyTitle: Copy of mail sent in this user's name
userDetail.sentCopyDesc: Without a copy here, a shared mailbox holds no record of what went out in its name.
userDetail.copySendAs: Keep a copy of mail sent as this user in its Sent Items
userDetail.copySendOnBehalf: Keep a copy of mail sent on this user's behalf in its Sent Items
userDetail.copyExclusive: Make this copy the only one (the sender keeps none)
userDetail.sentCopyHint: The sender keeps their own copy unless the last option is on. The last option has no effect unless one of the first two filed a copy, and a sender's mail client that saves its own copy (IMAP) still does.
userDetail.foldersDesc: Choose a folder to see and change who may open it.
userDetail.rolesDesc: Panel roles this user holds. An organization or domain role is limited to that scope.
userDetail.devicesDesc: ActiveSync devices that have synchronized with this mailbox.
userDetail.policyDesc: A per-user override. Each field overrides the server default; leave it on inherit to take the default. Password rules apply only when DevicePasswordEnabled is Yes.
userDetail.deleteDesc: The account is removed from the directory. This cannot be undone.
userDetail.deleteFiles: Also delete the mailbox files from disk
userDetail.thresholdInvalid: Threshold must be at least 1, or empty to inherit.
userDetail.devicesUnread: Could not read the mobile devices.
userDetail.fetchmailUnread: Could not read the remote accounts.

folderPerms.none: No permissions are set on this folder.
folderPerms.noSuchMember: No such user. Grant to the recipient's primary address.

userQuarantine.subject: Subject
userQuarantine.releaseFailed: Could not release the message, it may already have been moved.
userQuarantine.deleteFailed: Could not delete the message, it may already be gone.
userQuarantine.junkUnread: Could not read the Junk folder.

userDevices.confirmWipe: Remote wipe {0}? This erases the device.
userDevices.confirmAccountWipe: Account-only wipe {0}? This removes the account from the device.

userRoles.scopeIDTitle: Org or domain id; 0 for a system role
userRoles.rolesUnread: Could not read the admin roles.
